meta.based_on: T-10M Oplot-MO platform with a hypothetical GSh-6-23-informed six-barrel 23×115 mm installation
meta.notes: Rebuilt from the general-view drawing of the T-10M with the Oplot-MO (side, plan and front views, gridded at their scales): lofted hull sections and cast turret sections, running gear positions, the M-62-T2 and the Oplot-MO housing as drawn; the coaxial KPVT is removed as the drawing's table lists. The Oplot-MO gun's dip by bearing is from the drawing of its depression limits. Gear ratios are estimates chosen to match the published 50 km/h; the 3BM-11, 3BK-9 and the Oplot-MO's rate of fire are approximate. Independent hypothetical/custom project modification; original 14.5 mm variant is retained. GSh-6-23-informed gun: six barrels, 76 kg, 1 m barrels, 715 m/s. 8000 rpm installation setting, belt500, API300+HEI200, reload30 s, spin-up0.35 s and tube spacing are project estimates. Hull total mass inherits source 52200 kg and has not been recalibrated for this installation. Ordinary Arsenal API/HEI index/copy evidence; projectile dimensions and curves are reference/project estimates. See docs/oplot23-research-2026-10-11.md for source and retrieval limits.
